summary.recommendation: Do not redistribute any base-import dataset or derived values until rights are established in writing. Research-grade internal attribution is unaffected.

techpowerup_legacy_44_disposition_recomm.body: Retain the 44 values in the database, flagged for review, but treat any future redistribution (export, publish, bundled dataset) as needing written permission from TechPowerUp (w1zzard@techpowerup.com). Do not delete the values: they are factual specification cells already in the DB, 16 of 44 were cross-checked against NVIDIA official pages, and there is no technical or legal justification for removal; deletion would destroy provenance history. Do not treat the prior possession/import as a redistribution grant.
